You can use std::ranges::find(

std::ranges::find requires the range element type to satisfy stricter comparison concepts with the search value. 

Since copyRecords and skipRecords are nlohmann::json arrays, the JSON element type does not satisfy those constraints when searched with a std::string, causing compilation failure. 

std::find works directly with the JSON iterators without requiring conversion to a typed container.
